title: About FlowExtract API: Who Builds These Scrapers
metaDescription: FlowExtract API is an independent developer publishing data extraction tools on the Apify Store. How the tools are built, priced and supported.
intro: FlowExtract API is an independent developer that builds and maintains data extraction tools ("actors") on the Apify Store, under the profile dz_omar. Every tool on this site runs on Apify, which handles the servers, scheduling, storage and billing.
